desc: Derive the complete characterization of allowed ordered coprime factorizations \(P_iQ_i=A_i\), including an efficient enumeration method.
Derive the prime-wise normalized-height DP, including handling of new minima and score accumulation.
Prove independence across primes and that the product of local sums equals the global answer.
Establish time and memory complexity for \(N\le 1000,\ A_i\le 1000\).
Implement the algorithm in Python with modular arithmetic and validate it against brute force and all provided samples.
